description: Two-panel image in the style of a video thumbnail. The left panel shows an elderly white-haired man posed in a white robe holding a Ku Klux Klan hood and folded robe; this widely circulated picture is presented as Sen. Robert Byrd but has been widely reported as digitally altered. The right panel is the well-known 2004 photograph of Hillary Clinton embracing and kissing Sen. Robert Byrd on the cheek. The pairing implies an association between Clinton and the KKK via Byrd, a former Klan member.
flags: Left panel purporting to show Robert Byrd in KKK regalia is widely reported as a digitally manipulated image

description: Screenshot of a verified Daily Caller tweet dated Jan 31, 2018, headlined that a Hamas co-founder died after accidentally shooting himself in the face (the article refers to Imad al-Alami, who was actually injured, dying weeks later). The attached photo shows a bearded man in a dark suit speaking into a microphone and gesturing, seated before a Palestinian flag, a Hamas flag, and a backdrop with Arabic text; the man is consistent with Hamas political leader Ismail Haniyeh, not the man in the headline.
text: The Daily Caller @DailyCaller. Hamas Co-Founder Dies After Accidentally Shooting Himself In The Face trib.al/1APRR0z. نحمي القدس بوحدتنا. 11:58 PM · Jan 31, 2018
flags: Pictured man identified as Ismail Haniyeh with high but not absolute confidence; he is not the subject of the headline
Headline is the outlet's claim; al-Alami was reported injured Jan 2018 and died weeks later

description: Mobile screenshot of a news article reporting that Hamas co-founder Imad al-Alami died on a Tuesday, three weeks after accidentally shooting himself in the face while cleaning/examining his personal weapon on Jan. 9, citing a Hamas statement to the Associated Press. An embedded, unplayed video thumbnail sits mid-article. The article notes al-Alami helped found the Gaza-based group in the mid-1980s and that the U.S., Israel and the EU consider Hamas a terrorist organization. The final paragraph is cut off.
text: A co-founder of Hamas died Tuesday, three weeks after shooting himself in the face while looking down the barrel of a gun he was cleaning. Imad al-Alami was “examining his personal weapon in his home” Jan. 9 when he accidentally pulled the trigger and put a bullet in his head, Hamas said Tuesday night in a statement to the Associated Press. Al-Alami helped found the Gaza-based Palestinian group during the mid-1980s.
